correctness.rationale: The 16 geometric J[2] classes are even subsets modulo complements, and maximal Weil-isotropic subgroups biject with the 15 perfect matchings of the six branch labels. Frobenius acts by a permutation with cycle lengths equal to irreducible degrees, so all eleven partitions exhaust the possibilities. Package code generates all 15 matchings and 16 torsion classes, verifies each action as cycles and independently by fixed points of every permutation power, verifies exactly two zeta collisions and the distinct F7 squarefree examples. There are no infinite extrapolations: the uniform assertion follows formally from S6-equivariance.

value.rationale: A complete finite étale descent classification of all fifteen maximal isotropic genus-two (2,2)-isogeny kernels is a natural exact invariant for arithmetic isogeny construction. The two distinct six-root types giving the same full kernel zeta but different rational two-torsion detect a mathematically important distinction between descent of subgroup schemes and pointwise-defined generators, while the irreducible sextic gives a rational kernel with no nonzero rational two-torsion. This goes beyond one small sample of curve equations, but adds no new general Galois mechanism.
